query: Show, for each artist, their top selling track and its total revenue
sql_used:
SELECT 
    a.Name AS ArtistName,
    t.Name AS TrackName,
    SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue
FROM 
    Artist a
JOIN 
    Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
JOIN 
    Track tr ON al.AlbumId = tr.AlbumId
JOIN 
    InvoiceLine il ON tr.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY 
    a.Name, tr.Name
ORDER BY 
    a.Name, TotalRevenue DESC;
